name: Deel
desc: Global hiring, payroll and EOR platform — pay contractors and employees compliantly in 150+ countries, from $49 per contractor per month, with HR tools and US PEO options.

name: Dripify
desc: Cloud-based LinkedIn outreach automation — drip sequences of connection requests, messages, InMails and profile views, with configurable daily limits and a built-in email finder. From $39 per user/month billed annually, 7-day free trial without a card.

name: EngageBay
desc: All-in-one CRM, marketing, helpdesk and live chat for small teams — a genuine free tier (250 contacts) and per-user suites that undercut the big names.

name: Retouch4me
desc: AI retouching plugins for photographers (Photoshop-compatible, Mac/Windows) — lifetime licenses per plugin (Heal/Crop $145, Dodge&Burn $179), full-suite subscriptions from $169/year with retouch credits, or pay-as-you-go cloud retouching at $0.10/photo. Free to try first: signing up gives 20 cloud retouches at no cost (site, verified 23 Jul 2026).

name: Serpstat
desc: All-in-one SEO platform — keyword research, competitor analysis, rank tracking, site audit and backlink data — from $50/month on annual billing ($69 month-to-month), with a 7-day trial that takes a card and auto-renews.

name: World Businesses for Sale
desc: International marketplace for buying and selling established businesses — restaurants, shops, services and manufacturers — free for buyers, with broker plans (listing fee plus 1-3% commission) or no-commission pay-as-you-go listings, and 24/7 guidance for sellers.

name: Convert
desc: Privacy-first A/B testing platform — experiments, personalization and feature rollouts, priced by tested users. Via our link: an exclusive 30-day full-access trial (standard is 15 days).

name: Alli AI
desc: Agency-grade SEO automation — bulk on-page optimizations, rules and keyword tracking across multiple sites and CMSes from one dashboard.

name: BillingNow
desc: Invoicing and expense tracking with AI — unlimited invoices, expenses, clients and users on one flat $9.99/month plan, made in Geneva.

name: Thordata
desc: Proxy infrastructure and scraping stack — residential, mobile, ISP and datacenter proxies plus SERP/web-scraper APIs, priced per GB, IP or 1K requests.

name: PagePulse
desc: Per-page site analytics with heatmaps and AI-summarised insights. Free for one member and one page; Starter at $29/month buys one member and two pages. The tiers gate on members and tracked pages at once, and the 'unlimited traffic' promise carries a fair-use footnote.

name: Bread & Butter
desc: Lead-intelligence platform with server-side tracking: captures the full visitor journey from the first visit, then enriches, scores and nurtures the moment someone submits an email — verified identities instead of IP-based company guesses. 30-day full trial, then a genuinely usable freemium tier; Pro from $49 per website.

name: Oneflow
desc: Digital contract platform for the full lifecycle — create, negotiate, e-sign and archive interactive contracts, with AI-assisted contract features and CRM/HR/ATS integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce), from €250/month (5 users, annual billing).

name: Team Pulse
desc: Projects, tasks, chat, files and a light CRM pipeline in one tool. The tiers gate on members and projects at once, and the pipeline does not exist below the $79 Growth plan — Starter at $29 is a single seat with five projects. The listed rates assume annual billing.

name: Moosend
desc: Email marketing and automation platform — drag-and-drop campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages and subscription forms, priced by contact-list size with a 30-day free trial and pay-as-you-go email credits as an alternative.

name: Clutch
desc: B2B services marketplace — submit a free project brief and get matched with verified, best-fit agencies for your project, no research required.

name: Clonable
desc: Creates a continuously-translated clone of your existing website — fast multilingual versions that stay synced as your site changes, without rebuilding it.

name: Leavo
desc: Team time-tracking, attendance and overtime banking with transparent per-user pricing and a 30-day free trial.

name: BabyLoveGrowth
desc: AI SEO/GEO content automation — auto-publishes optimized articles, builds backlinks and runs keyword research, aimed at fast hands-off organic growth for lean teams.

name: Lucrovox
desc: AI phone agent for local service businesses — answers missed calls, books jobs and captures leads 24/7 for trades like HVAC, plumbing and roofing.

name: Pythago
desc: AI analytics and ROI tracking for dropshippers — real-time ROAS optimization, product research and competitor tools across one or more Shopify stores.

name: Insightful
desc: Workforce analytics and productivity monitoring — time tracking, workflow optimization and insider-threat detection, priced per seat.

name: Expandi
desc: LinkedIn and email outreach automation for sales teams and agencies — smart limits, warm-up and multi-account management.

name: WebinarGeek
desc: European live and automated webinar platform — viewer-tier pricing, engagement tools, CRM integrations and GDPR-friendly hosting. The vendor states you can now generate a full webinar — including polls, quizzes and a registration page — from a plain-text description, with UTM tracking and post-webinar redirects on the registration page (vendor mail, August 2026).

name: Wegic
desc: AI website builder that generates and hosts sites from a conversation — credit-based, with custom domains and code export on higher tiers, and built-in image generation powered by ChatGPT Image-2 (upload a reference or prompt, drop the result straight into your design). It can also turn a single product photo or mockup into a ready-to-sell product page. A one-click optimize pass audits a published site for SEO and site-health problems and applies the fixes itself — vendor-announced in July 2026, and not something we have tested.

name: Pricefy
desc: Competitor price monitoring and dynamic repricing for e-commerce — AI product matching, price-intelligence dashboards, feed channels and autopilot repricing.

name: Signeasy
desc: E-signature and contract management for SMBs — unlimited signing and sending, templates, audit trails and integrations, priced per seat.

name: AhaSlides
desc: Interactive presentation platform — live polls, quizzes, word clouds and audience Q&A, free for up to 50 participants.

name: Algomo
desc: AI inbound agent and website personalization for B2B — qualifies visitors by identity, holds contextual conversations and books meetings from your existing traffic.

name: Geotargetly
desc: Geo-targeting toolkit — location-based redirects, content swaps, popups and personalization by country, state and city, priced by traffic volume.

name: Warmup Inbox
desc: Standalone email warm-up service — automated inbox warming, deliverability monitoring and integrations for Google, Outlook, Zoho and SendGrid.

name: UptimeRobot
desc: Uptime monitoring with a generous free tier — website, port, keyword and API checks down to 60-second intervals, status pages, integrations and mobile apps.

name: GrapeLeads
desc: Lead-finding for web developers and agencies — surfaces local businesses without websites from Google Maps, with contact details, on signup credits.

name: Joiin
desc: Financial consolidation and group reporting for multi-entity, multi-currency organisations — connects Xero, QuickBooks and Sage, with unlimited users and reports on every plan.

name: Audiorista
desc: No-code platform for launching branded audio apps — podcasts, audiobooks, meditation and courses with subscriptions, on iOS, Android and web.

name: Reditus
desc: Affiliate-program software plus marketplace for B2B SaaS: launch, manage and scale a partner program with tracking, automated payouts and affiliate discovery.

name: Woodpecker
desc: Cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform priced by contacted prospects — unlimited team seats and email accounts, built-in warm-ups, deliverability tooling and a lead finder.

name: EmailListVerify
desc: Email verification with never-expiring pay-as-you-go credits — bulk list cleaning, real-time API, inbox-placement testing and free DMARC/SPF tools, plus a credit-based email finder.

name: Payoneer
desc: Local receiving accounts for freelancers and sellers paid by international clients and marketplaces. Free to open — the cost sits in the fees: 1% on non-local currency received, 1.2–4% on conversion, $1.50 flat to withdraw locally, and a $29.95 annual fee waived above $6,000 received.

name: Bill.com
desc: Accounts-payable and receivable automation for finance teams with real approval chains. Priced per user from about $45/month, with transaction fees stacked on top — roughly $0.49 ACH, $1.99 cheque, $9.99 international wire, 2.9% card.

name: Tax1099
desc: Per-form e-filing of 1099s, W-2s and related forms, falling to about $0.68 a form at high volume, with an eFile Plus subscription near $249/year for frequent filers. TIN matching, W-9 requests, state filing and corrections can each carry their own charge, so tally the add-ons.

name: Flippa
desc: Marketplace for buying and selling online businesses, SaaS, apps and domains. Self-serve, so the due diligence is yours. Sellers pay a listing fee from about $29 plus a success fee starting near 3% — a bracket rate on the whole sale price, not a marginal one.

name: Credit Repair Cloud
desc: Software for running a credit-repair business: client management, dispute automation and letter workflows. It is not a tool for repairing your own credit. Plans run from about $49/month (Personal) to $599 (Enterprise), scaling by active clients and seats.

name: Bitvavo
desc: Dutch-regulated, euro-native crypto exchange with deep EUR pairs and an API for automation. No subscription — the base tier under €100k monthly volume runs about 0.15% maker and 0.25% taker, dropping through nine volume tiers. Sign up via our link for €10K fee-free.

name: Bybit
desc: Crypto exchange covering spot, perpetuals and options. No subscription — spot is 0.1% maker and taker for non-VIP, derivatives around 0.02% and 0.055%, with volume tiers cutting lower. Funding rates on perpetuals are a recurring cost the fee table does not show, and availability differs per country.

name: ActiveCampaign
desc: Marketing automation and lifecycle email with a light CRM attached. Priced by contact count from about $15/month on Starter, with CRM pipelines, SMS and extra seats sold as add-ons — the sticker price sits well below what a real automation setup costs.

name: Close
desc: Sales CRM unifying calling, email and SMS in one inbox, for teams that live on the phone. Seats run about $9 (Solo) to $139 (Scale) per user/month billed annually, and call, SMS and Power Dialer credits bill separately on top — a $99 plan can land nearer $160 once a rep dials all day.

name: Vista Social
desc: Unified social media management and publishing. Schedule posts, manage conversations, and track analytics across all your brand accounts.

name: Reply.io
desc: AI-driven sales engagement platform. Automate your cold outreach across email, LinkedIn, and calls while keeping the human touch. Now includes a mobile app (Jason AI) for iOS and Android to run outreach on the go.

name: Alidrop
desc: Dropshipping automation — product sourcing, fulfilment and inventory sync, with access to faster-shipping US and EU suppliers. Plans run $39/month for 50 unique products up to $299. The subscription sits on top of wholesale cost, so margins still turn on product selection and ad efficiency.

name: Smartli
desc: AI writing suite for e-commerce: product listings, ad copy, SEO text and brand assets. Monthly runs $39 (Starter) to $299; on annual billing Starter disappears and Pro drops to about $24/month. Each of the nine tools is competent rather than deep, so leaning hard on one job means outgrowing it.

name: Logome.ai
desc: Generates a logo and basic brand assets from a prompt. Designing and previewing is free, but downloading requires a paid plan — Basic at around $29/month gives one file without a transparent background. Their public site including pricing returned 404 at last check, so verify what you are charged.

name: AISDR
desc: Deploy an autonomous AI Sales Development Rep. It qualifies leads, books meetings, and handles initial outreach conversations 24/7.

name: ElevateForward
desc: An operational execution and alignment platform (Elevate Studio) for scaling companies, structured in three layers — Strategy (set priorities and initiatives), Execution (track initiatives, workstreams, ownership and KPIs), and Momentum (adoption, change management and follow-through). It turns strategy into structured, visible execution rather than task lists.

name: Success.co
desc: Strategy execution and OKR platform. Turn goals into action: set objectives, track KPIs and scorecards, run meetings and align teams so strategy actually gets executed rather than just planned.

name: GetResponse
desc: Email marketing with landing pages, automation and webinars in one suite, priced by contact count. Starter is €16/month (€13.12 billed annually) and allows a single automation workflow; unlimited workflows start on Marketer at €54. The better rates need long commitments.

name: Campaign Monitor
desc: Email campaigns with strong templates and client-friendly management for brands and agencies. Priced per contact rather than per send: Essentials at 10,000 contacts runs about $89/month, so dormant subscribers bill like active ones. Automation depth is lighter than dedicated platforms.

name: Amplemarket
desc: An all-in-one AI sales platform: an AI 'Searcher' that turns a plain-English ICP into verified contacts, 100+ contact-level buying-intent signals, and social prospecting from LinkedIn, plus multichannel outreach and deliverability tooling — drawing on a large multi-source contact database it refreshes continuously. Its Duo copilot proactively surfaces prioritized leads from 20+ real-time signal types, and an MCP server puts the platform inside ChatGPT or Claude — where it can triage the Unibox, update or remove leads, and since July run a whole account-based play end to end: research the account, pull enriched profiles, and enrol every contact into one sequence with copy written per person and per step, without leaving the chat. A GTM Skills Library exposes the rest of the platform the same way. Since June you can also describe a workflow in plain English and have it built for you in the normal editor, and meeting notes from Fathom and Attention flow into the activity feed. Deliverability is a named toolkit rather than a footnote: a Domain Health Center for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox-to-outbox ratio, spam-list and mailbox-age monitoring; automated warm-up and recovery for flagged Gmail or Outlook mailboxes; weekly spam-placement tests before a campaign goes out; and Duo rotating the sending mailbox per email against that same health data. Workflows, the automation layer, is included for every customer rather than sold as a premium add-on: triggers (a sequence finishing with no reply, a bounce, a meeting booked, a call logged, a CRM field changing), filters for who qualifies, branching paths and actions (enrol in another sequence, update CRM fields, create tasks, manage lists, enrich, add to exclusion lists), assembled on a visual canvas so the whole logic is readable at a glance. Twenty ready-made Recipes cover lead routing, keeping non-responders warm, account plays, CRM hygiene and do-not-contact enforcement. It runs against Salesforce and HubSpot out of the box, and without a CRM connected the triggers and actions that don't depend on one still work. The browser extension carries the same work into whatever page you are on: adding and editing notes, creating and running tasks, and filtering the activity feed without switching tabs.

name: Omniseo
desc: AI search visibility (GEO) tracking. Monitor and improve how your brand shows up in AI answers across ChatGPT, Google AI and other channels — track prompts, competitors and citations to grow AI-driven discovery.

name: Seamless.ai
desc: B2B contact database with AI list-building, plus an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can run the searching and enrichment. Paid plans are quote-based, reported around $147/month for 250 credits. Independent tests put deliverability near 74%, and contracts auto-renew with 30–60 days' notice to cancel.

name: Unbounce
desc: Landing page builder for paid campaigns, with A/B testing and Smart Traffic routing each visitor to the best-converting variant. From $74/month (Build) to $187 (Optimize), and the visitor caps — around 20,000 a month on Build — push you up a tier when a campaign takes off.

name: Iconosquare
desc: Social analytics, reporting and competitor benchmarking, deepest on Instagram and the core networks. Free for one user and two profiles, then Launch around €33/month and Scale €69. Tiers gate on seats and profiles, so agencies managing many brands climb faster than the entry price suggests.

name: Adwisely
desc: Automated retargeting and prospecting ads on Meta and Google for Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce stores. Costs a $49/month minimum plus 10% of the ad spend it manages (capped at $3,250 a month), so work the effective rate out at your own spend.

name: AdCreative.ai
desc: AI ad-creative and banner generation for performance marketers. Metered by download rather than by campaign: tiers run from roughly $29–39/month for 10 credits up to $249/month for 200, so iteration-heavy testing burns a starter allowance fast.

name: Landingi
desc: Landing page builder with 400+ templates, from $29/month for unlimited pages and 5,000 visitors; A/B testing and pop-ups start at $49. Roughly half what Unbounce and Instapage charge, and the trade is no AI traffic routing, no real-time collaboration and thinner technical control.

name: AISQ
desc: An autonomous marketing execution engine. Consolidates SEO, content distribution, and strategy into one automated workflow.

name: ManyChat
desc: Comment-to-DM and chat funnels for Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and SMS. Flows are button-and-script based, so an unexpected reply falls back. The free tier holds 25 contacts and billing scales with the list — roughly $131/month at 10,000 contacts and $507 at 25,000.

name: Printify
desc: Global print-on-demand network. Create custom products and automate your e-commerce fulfillment without holding inventory.

name: Frase
desc: AI-powered SEO content writing and optimization. Research, outline, write, and optimize articles that rank — all in one place.

name: Clay
desc: Waterfall enrichment and custom research workflows for go-to-market teams. It enriches rather than sends, so you still need a separate email tool. From about $185/month (Launch, 2,500 credits) to $495 (Growth), with credit spend that is hard to forecast and a two-to-four-week learning curve.

name: Rank Math
desc: WordPress SEO plugin with schema, on-page analysis and rank tracking. The free version is generous enough that many sites never need to upgrade; PRO, from about $6.99/month billed annually, earns its keep once you want rank tracking, Content AI credits or many client sites.

name: Atria
desc: Competitor ad research and AI creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform. Credit-metered: Core is about $159/month ($129 annual) with 4,000 AI credits and 50 brands tracked, and heavy users step up to Plus at roughly twice that.

name: Beehiiv
desc: Newsletter platform with growth, automation, SEO and monetisation tooling, priced by subscriber count. You keep 100% of paid subscriptions where Substack takes 10%; the trade is a steeper start than Substack's near-zero setup and built-in discovery.

name: ClickUp
desc: The 'everything app' for project and work management. Centralize your tasks, docs, sprints, and team communication in one hub.

name: Trainual
desc: Documents SOPs and runs new-hire onboarding, with AI that drafts and updates training docs from your own account context. Not publicly priced: third-party sources put Core near $249/month for up to 10 seats billed annually, plus a reported one-time implementation fee around $1,000.

name: Beautiful.ai
desc: Presentation builder whose templates lay themselves out as you type. Pro is about $12/month billed annually but $45 month-to-month — a steep gap — and the constraints that make decks look consistent also block pixel-level custom layouts.

name: Gamma
desc: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a deck, document or webpage draft. Credit-metered: the free tier gives 400 one-time credits and carries Gamma branding, Plus is about $12/month for 1,000 credits. Output still needs a human pass for high-stakes decks.

name: Databox
desc: Centralized KPI dashboards. Pull data from all your software tools into one clean interface to monitor your business health. A free Skills Marketplace adds guided analyses on top: the paid-ads skill standardizes every ad channel into one efficiency table with CPA gauges against your own targets, judged per funnel role. A native MCP server (mcp.databox.com) puts those metrics inside ChatGPT or Claude — ingest data and query it in plain language. It runs on every paid plan, not on Free, and its queries spend from the same monthly AI-credit pool as Genie.

name: Tradify
desc: Specialized job management software for trade businesses. Handle quoting, scheduling, and invoicing from the field.

name: Reclaim.ai
desc: Auto-schedules tasks, habits and meetings around your stated priorities. Google Calendar-first, so Outlook-heavy teams are out, and the free tier is limited. Paid seats run about $8–10/month on Starter and Plus, roughly 29% cheaper on annual billing.

name: VEA
desc: AI built for entrepreneurs, not enterprises: VEA learns your business like a great employee would, finds the constraint keeping you stuck, and helps you solve it — then finds the next one.

name: SaneBox
desc: Email triage that moves low-priority mail out of the inbox and works with any provider. From about $3.49/month for one account up to $16.99 for four. The honest catch: you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern email clients increasingly sort for free.

name: Assembly
desc: Branded client portal for agencies and professional service firms: messaging, invoices, proposals, contracts and e-signatures in one place. Two meters run at once — Starter stops at 50 clients on $39/month billed yearly, and each extra internal user costs $39 on Professional and $59 on Advanced.

name: Increff
desc: Warehouse management plus algorithm-driven merchandising and inventory optimisation for omnichannel retail. There is no public pricing and no flat fee — every deal is quoted case by case against warehouses, users and modules, so budget for an enterprise implementation.

name: QuillBot
desc: Paraphrasing, grammar, summarising and plagiarism checking in one box of writing utilities. The free tier caps paraphrasing at 125 words and two modes, and the advertised $4.17/month assumes a year paid up front — no month-to-month rate is published.

name: Lindy.ai
desc: An AI teammate that lives in Slack: @mention it and it works across your other tools, sits in meetings for shared context and runs jobs on a schedule. Sold per user — Plus $29.99/month for 3k credits, Pro $99.99 for 15k — so cost tracks headcount, and a removed seat runs to the end of the cycle.

name: Typewise
desc: AI text prediction and drafted replies for enterprise support floors, tuned to your own vocabulary. From about €12/user/month for team plans, with real deployments quote-driven and priced on usage or outcome. The value case rests on measured agent-time saved — insist on that from the pilot.

name: Turbotic
desc: Enterprise automation orchestration. Manage your entire ecosystem of RPA, AI, and scripts from a single control tower.

name: Pangram
desc: AI content detector. Identifies AI-generated text with a focus on minimizing false positives — used by educators, publishers and platforms to verify whether writing is human or machine, via web app and API. The vendor's Pangram 4.0 release (July 2026) claims a false-positive rate of 1 in 10,000, detection of output from the newest frontier models, resistance to "humanized" text written to evade detection, and improved boundary detection between human and AI passages. An early research preview adds AI image detection, flagging which segments of an image appear AI-generated and verifying C2PA content credentials where present.

name: Synthesia
desc: AI avatar video for training, explainers and onboarding: type a script, no camera or actors needed. Priced in video-minute credits — Basic is free with about 10 minutes a month and no downloads, Starter $18/month billed yearly for 120 minutes a year. Re-generating an edit spends the minutes again.

name: InVideo
desc: Turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video with AI voiceover, templates and stock footage. AI minutes are metered and do not roll over: Plus is around $28/month for roughly 50 minutes, Max $50–60 for 200. The free tier is watermarked, so it serves as evaluation only.

name: Murf
desc: AI voiceover generation for explainers, courses and product video. Metered in generation hours per year rather than per month: Creator is about $29/month for 24 hours a year, and every retake of a script bills again.

name: Jotform AI Agents
desc: Build AI chatbots and customer-service agents in minutes — no code required. Handles leads, support tickets and bookings 24/7. Integrates with your existing forms and CRMs.

name: CloudTalk
desc: Cloud call centre with call routing, analytics and CRM integrations, from €19/user/month on annual billing (Expert €49 needs at least three licences). AI voice agents are separate subscriptions from €99/month for 200 minutes, and number rental plus outbound minutes stack on top of the seat price.

name: Calilio
desc: Cloud phone system with international numbers and call menus, from about $12/user/month annual on Standard. Numbers, minutes and SMS meter separately from a credit balance, so an active team's real bill sits above the per-seat price.

name: KrispCall
desc: Virtual numbers across 100+ countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks, from about $12/user/month on annual billing. Calls and SMS are pay-as-you-go from a separate credit balance, so compare per-country call rates at your volume rather than the seat price.

name: Vida AI
desc: Deploy autonomous frontline voice agents. Let AI answer calls, book appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7 without sounding robotic.

name: CometChat
desc: In-app text, voice and video chat infrastructure to embed into your own software — secure and scalable, with a free developer plan and, via the new Air release, fully on-prem or air-gapped deployment for regulated enterprises.

name: MindStudio
desc: Visual builder for AI agents and workflows across 200+ models, with model usage passed through at provider cost and no markup. The real bill is therefore subscription plus model spend: Individual is about $20/month, and a looping agent burns provider credits until you set caps.

name: Consensus
desc: AI search across peer-reviewed literature: it reports what published studies found, not whether those studies are sound. A free tier covers basic search; Pro is about $15/month, or roughly $10 billed annually. Study quality and conflicting results still need your own judgment.

name: Proton Drive
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage from a Swiss provider. Free at 2–5 GB; Drive Plus about $3.99/month annual for 200 GB. Because Proton cannot read your files there is no server-side search inside documents, integrations are thinner, and losing your credentials without recovery loses the data.

name: IDrive
desc: Cloud backup across many devices, with versioning, snapshots and physical seed-and-restore shipping. Personal is 5 TB at $9.99/month, shown at $6.99 on annual billing — but that discount is first-year only and the renewal step is about 43%, so budget on year-two rates.

name: Runpod
desc: Serverless GPU compute platform. Rent high-end NVIDIA GPUs by the hour to train and deploy your own machine learning models.

name: Bitdefender
desc: GravityZone endpoint protection for small business, managed from one console. Roughly $57–96 per device per year at list on an annual plan. The first year is promotional and renews higher, so budget for the renewal rate rather than the intro.

name: Browse.ai
desc: No-code web scraping and data extraction. Turn any website into an automated data pipeline or spreadsheet automatically.

name: Plesk
desc: Server control panel for agencies and hosters running many sites — per-domain management, security and one-click stacks. Licensed per server from about $14–18/month for 10 domains. Domain caps drive the tier, and a roughly 26% average price rise took effect in January 2026.

name: Emergent
desc: AI app builder. Describe what you want and Emergent builds full-stack web apps for you — an agentic, credit-based platform that turns prompts into working software with no manual coding.

name: Airia
desc: Enterprise AI orchestration and governance platform. Build, deploy and govern AI agents and automated workflows at scale — no-code/low-code/pro-code agent builder, connectors and MCP support, with security and governance built into the orchestration layer. Its July 2026 product update, as the vendor describes it, added three governance pieces: Model Change Management, which warns up to 90 days before a model deprecation so agents do not break silently; Advanced Context Engineering, aimed at running governed AI over complex, permission-sensitive enterprise data; and cost controls that watch budgets in real time, attribute spend per provider, model, agent and team, and flag runaway agent loops.

name: Expertise AI
desc: AI sales agent for B2B websites. Replaces a static chatbot with a live, RAG-grounded agent that holds buying conversations, qualifies visitors and routes them to reps or calendar slots — HubSpot-first, with visitor intelligence.

name: Ngram
desc: AI video creation for product and marketing teams. Turn docs, screenshots and recordings into polished, on-brand videos — scripted, storyboarded and produced with AI on a credit-based model. A published blog post or doc URL is a valid starting point in its own right: paste the link and it handles the research, script, storyboard, voice and style choice and the render in one sitting, with no editor in the loop, and hands back a shareable public link or an embed.

name: Replit
desc: Browser-based coding environment with instant deploys and an AI agent. Billing is effort-based: Core is $20/month including $25 of credits, Pro $95/month billed annually including $100. Credits expire monthly and a complex agent session burns them fast, which makes production costs hard to budget.

name: NordVPN
desc: Secure VPN with threat protection for business & remote teams

name: Hostinger
desc: Affordable, fast hosting with an AI website builder built in. Free domain, free SSL and 24/7 support — perfect for founders launching their first MVP or side project.

name: ChemiCloud
desc: Lightning-fast cloud hosting with free migrations, daily backups, and 24/7 expert support. Perfect balance of performance and affordability for growing businesses.

name: Kinsta
desc: Managed WordPress hosting on Google Cloud, with free migrations and 24/7 support. From about $35/month for one site (25,000 visits, 10 GB), or roughly $29 billed annually. Exceeding the visit cap bills per 1,000 extra visits, and Kinsta confirms it offers no partner-only discount codes.

name: WP Rocket
desc: WordPress caching and performance plugin: page cache, lazy loading, file optimisation and CDN integration from one settings screen. Licensed annually from about $59 for one site to $299 for many, all tiers feature-identical. Stop paying and you keep your settings but lose updates and support.

name: Aircall
desc: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams: call routing, analytics and CRM integrations. A three-licence minimum applies, so entry is effectively about $90/month; Essentials is roughly $30/user/month annual against $40 month-to-month.

name: Katana MRP
desc: Cloud manufacturing and inventory platform for product businesses. Live inventory control, production scheduling and order syncing across your sales channels — know exactly what to make and when.

name: Process Street
desc: Recurring work as trackable checklists and SOPs, with approvals and conditional logic. Pricing is opaque: Startup begins near $100/month for up to five members and steps up to a custom Pro tier in the $1,500/month range, with seat minimums on top.

name: Gusto
desc: Payroll, benefits and HR in one friendly platform. Automated tax filings, employee onboarding and time tracking — run payroll for your whole team in just a few clicks.

name: Bright Data
desc: The web data platform trusted by enterprises. Collect public web data at scale with proxies, ready-made datasets and scraping APIs — fuel for your market research and AI projects.

name: SmartSuite
desc: One flexible work management platform to plan, track and automate any process. Projects, CRM and operations side by side — replace a stack of scattered tools with a single source of truth.

name: Melio
desc: Bill payments for small businesses by bank transfer or card, syncing with your accounting tools. The free Go plan covers five ACH transfers a month, then $0.50 each; Core is about $25/month. Card payments carry a flat 2.9%, which only pays off when you are deliberately floating cash.

name: Quo
desc: Shared business numbers, texting and AI call summaries for small teams, formerly OpenPhone. About $15/user/month on annual billing, plus telecom taxes and surcharges in 16 US states. Call reliability off Wi-Fi is the recurring complaint, and there is no video conferencing.

name: Flocksy
desc: A dedicated creative team for one flat monthly fee. Unlimited graphic design, video editing, motion graphics and web design — your marketing never waits on a freelancer again.

name: Shippo
desc: Multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce. Compare rates, print discounted labels and automate tracking across carriers — shipping that scales with your store.

name: TaxCycle
desc: Professional tax preparation and CRA e-filing for Canadian accountants and bookkeepers. Quote-based and priced by module and firm size, with reported figures ranging from roughly CAD 1,680 into five figures for full suites. Canada-only, and not a consumer filing app.

name: Alohi
desc: One secure ecosystem for document workflows: Sign.Plus e-signatures, Fax.Plus online faxing and Scan.Plus scanning — paperwork handled, compliance included.

name: WebCatalog
desc: Turn web apps into tidy desktop apps and manage multiple accounts side by side. Less tab chaos, more focus — your whole stack organized in one place.

name: Livestorm
desc: Browser-based webinars with registration, automated emails, polls and analytics. There is no plan price: Pro sells attendee credits at €2.50 each, bought a year up front, and one credit is spent per unique participant per session — a four-part series to 200 people costs 800 credits.

name: Volza
desc: Export-import trade intelligence: search customs-level shipment records to find verified buyers and suppliers. From about $1,500 a year for 3B+ shipment records across 200+ countries. Downloads run on points that cost more in thinner markets, and some datasets refresh only every two months.

name: CallHippo
desc: AI-driven business phone system. Virtual numbers in 50+ countries, power dialer, call analytics and AI agents — set up your sales and support calling in minutes. Its omnichannel inbox threads voice, WhatsApp, SMS, email, Instagram and Telegram into one conversation per customer.

name: Bokun
desc: Booking management for tours and activities, by Tripadvisor. Manage availability, channel sales and online bookings in one place — built for experience businesses.

name: Shiftie
desc: Rota building, clock-ins, leave and shift swaps for shift-based businesses. Charged per active employee — roughly £2.75 a month, dropping to about £1.50 once you pass 30 staff, with entry plans from about £39. Not an HR or payroll platform, so those stay separate purchases.

name: Marketing 360
desc: All-in-one marketing platform for small business. Websites, CRM, ads, email and reputation management under one roof, with a unified reporting dashboard (their 'Intelligence' analytics) that pulls every channel, lead and sale into one view — and real humans to help run it.

name: SignNow
desc: Electronic signatures and custom eSignature workflows by airSlate. Send, sign and manage documents on any device — legally binding and team-friendly.

name: Gravity Forms
desc: Self-hosted WordPress form builder with conditional logic, payments and deep integrations. Licences run about $59/year for one site up to $259 for unlimited. WordPress-only, and much of the advanced power sits in paid add-ons that can add $99–349/year.

name: Goflow
desc: Multichannel e-commerce operations: orders, inventory, listings and shipping across all your marketplaces in one dashboard. Goflow Core is free and automates Amazon MCF fulfilment for TikTok Shop orders; the vendor states eligible orders may qualify for 35% savings on Amazon MCF rates (vendor mail, 27 Jul 2026). A nocnoc integration keeps Latin American listings, inventory, orders and fulfilment in sync from inside Goflow (vendor mail, 5 Aug 2026).

name: Readymode
desc: Predictive dialler with compliance tooling and supervisor monitoring for high-volume outbound floors. Starter is about $199/user/month and iQ $249 for five or more users, both with unlimited outbound minutes. Premium per seat, and predictive dialling carries real TCPA compliance responsibility.

name: Weave
desc: Phone, texting, payments and reviews unified for the front desk, tuned to dental, optometry and small healthcare practices. Quote-based per location: owners commonly report $400–700 per location per month plus a one-time setup fee near $750. Get the all-in number in writing.

name: Navan
desc: Business travel and expense management in one. Book trips, automate expense reports and control spend with real-time visibility.

name: Softr
desc: Build custom AI business apps, client portals and internal tools without code. Connect Airtable, Google Sheets or your data and launch in an afternoon.

name: MarketerHire
desc: Hire pre-vetted expert marketing talent on demand: growth marketers, paid ads specialists, email pros and more — matched to your business within days.

name: Toggl
desc: Time tracking for freelancers, consultants and agencies, with budgets, rates and profitability per project. Free up to five users; Starter about $9/user/month on annual billing. The paid line is drawn at whether you bill clients — track time for personal discipline and the free tier covers it.

name: Voye
desc: Pooled eSIM data for travelling teams, billed on actual usage rather than prepaid bundles, with per-user spend controls. Coverage and speed vary by country and carrier partner, so pilot your heaviest routes first — the vendor's roaming-savings figures stay claims until your invoice confirms them.

name: Jubilee
desc: Bankruptcy petition preparation, document automation and case management for legal practices. $95 per case pay-as-you-go, or annual plans from $995 for up to 36 filings to $4,995 for 500. Size the tier to your real filing volume; sporadic filers do better per case.

name: Bouncer
desc: Email-list verification sold as credits that never expire: $8 per 1,000 (also the minimum purchase), falling to about $2 per 1,000 at the top volume. Unknowns and duplicates are not charged. Treat 'accept-all' domain results as unverified.

name: SurveySparrow
desc: Conversational surveys and NPS with a polished respondent experience. A limited free plan, then roughly $19–39/month on Basic up to $149 on Business. Response limits on the lower tiers and a contact-sales wall on API and higher volume make budgeting fiddly, and there is no true monthly billing.

name: doola
desc: Business formation and compliance made easy. Launch your US LLC or C-Corp from anywhere globally, complete with banking and tax management.

name: Stampezee
desc: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Stamp Start is free for one branch, one card and up to 100 stamps; Stamp Lite is $29.99/month for two branches and three cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.

name: Wrike
desc: Work management for mid-to-large teams running cross-functional projects: reporting, workflows, approvals and resource management. Free up to five users; Team about $10/user/month and Business $25 on annual billing, with a five-seat minimum on Business.

name: Foxit
desc: PDF editing, OCR and organising priced under Acrobat: about $129.99/year for the desktop editor. The basket is modular — e-signing is a separate subscription with a five-user minimum on the business tier, and the AI assistant is a roughly $49.99/year add-on.

name: Contractor Foreman
desc: Construction management — estimating, scheduling, daily logs and financial tracking — priced per company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier. Annual runs $49/month for one user up to $332 for unlimited; quarterly billing costs about 26% more and Basic is annual-only.

name: 800.com
desc: Toll-free and vanity phone numbers for business, with call tracking, routing and analytics — plus 800 AI Agents (launched 2026) that answer calls, book appointments and filter spam when nobody picks up.

name: Pylon
desc: B2B customer support platform built for Slack and Microsoft Teams. Manage tickets, track issues, and deliver white-glove support directly where your clients chat.

name: Salesflare
desc: CRM for small B2B teams that auto-logs emails, meetings and contact details from your inbox and calendar. $29–99/user/month with no caps on contacts or pipelines. Deliberately lean: no built-in dialer, no quoting or invoicing, and basic reporting unless you export.

name: Dify
desc: Open-source platform for LLM apps and agent workflows: visual builder, RAG pipelines, model-agnostic. Free to self-host, but you own the servers, updates and reliability, and LLM tokens bill separately on every plan. Managed cloud runs about $59/month on Professional.

name: Later
desc: Visual social media scheduler and planner. Plan, preview and auto-publish posts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and more from one calendar.

name: Shorby
desc: Link-in-bio pages and short links, with messenger deep-links into WhatsApp or Telegram and retargeting pixels firing on every click. It charges from about $15/month where Linktree does not charge at all, so the gap only pays off if messenger selling or ad retargeting is genuinely your funnel.

name: Keap
desc: CRM, sales and marketing automation built for small businesses. Capture leads, automate follow-up and manage your pipeline in one place.

name: folk
desc: Lightweight, collaborative CRM for managing contacts and relationships. Centralize your network and personalize outreach without the bloat. A mobile app (Contacts by folk) adds on-the-go search, one-tap contact capture with business-card scanning, voice notes and interaction tracking across WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and calendar.

name: Outgrow
desc: Interactive content builder for quizzes, calculators, polls and assessments. Generate and qualify leads with engaging, no-code experiences, then sync them straight into Klaviyo via OAuth for email/SMS follow-up.

name: DropGenius
desc: Generates a Shopify dropshipping store — products, branding and copy — as a starting template, not a finished business. Monthly runs $39 to $299, and annual billing drops Starter. Trustpilot sat near 1.6/5 at research time, with recurring complaints about charges after cancellation.

name: Diginius
desc: Digital marketing and e-commerce performance platform. Manage PPC, analytics and product feeds to improve online sales and visibility.

name: Tresorit
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure file sharing. Protect sensitive business documents with zero-knowledge security and granular access controls.

name: Bolt Business
desc: Business travel and mobility management. Give your team expense-tracked rides and travel with centralized billing and reporting.

name: UENI
desc: A done-for-you small-business website, built for you rather than a builder you have to learn: a one-time build fee (promoted at $79 against a usual figure near $599) plus $24.99/month, including domain, email and a launch call. DIY editing is limited and the seven-day promise often slips.

name: CrankWheel
desc: No-download screen sharing for sales calls — a prospect clicks a link and sees your screen on any device. Deliberately narrow: no video conferencing, webinars or collaboration. The free plan covers one user and 15 meetings a month; Solo is about $29/user/month.

name: SocialBee
desc: Social media management and scheduling with content categories. Plan, recycle and publish posts across all your channels from one calendar.

name: Ownr
desc: Register or incorporate your business in Canada online and manage the legal admin: sole proprietorship or incorporation in minutes, plus contracts and documents — without a lawyer for every step. Canada-only, RBC-owned. Through our partner link, readers save 15% on registration or incorporation.

name: Todoist
desc: Task manager for individuals and small teams: quick capture, due dates and projects across devices. The free plan caps you at five projects and has no reminders, which moves most regular users to Pro at about $5/month billed annually. A to-do app, not a project suite with timelines or dependencies.

name: Aira
desc: AI-assisted B2B prospecting on a Europe-native company database, with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. About €149/month, with a money-back guarantee. The product is young and independent review coverage is thin, so test it against a concrete metric of your own.

name: Apollo
desc: Sales intelligence and engagement platform with a large B2B contact database. Find ideal-fit leads, enrich them and run multichannel outreach from one place.

name: Ruby
desc: Live human receptionists answering your calls, plus chat. Billed by receptionist-minute: roughly $235–385/month for 50–100 minutes, rising into four figures at higher volume, with chat bundles from about $112/month. Premium rates that pay off only when a missed call is a lost client.

name: Devs.ai
desc: Build and ship AI agents and apps across many models without engineering work. The seat price is the smaller half of the bill: Personal includes $10 of model usage a month and Business $21, metered on top — and the plan cards state the included amount without stating the rate once it runs out.

name: Salesmessage
desc: Business texting and SMS marketing in one shared inbox. Reach customers where they actually reply — two-way texting, automation and team collaboration.

name: Leadpages
desc: Landing pages, pop-ups and alert bars, with unlimited traffic on every Leadpages plan where metered rivals count visitors. Conversion plans run $99 (Grow) to $399 (Scale), alongside a separate HTML Pub publishing line at $10–49. The value pick rather than the optimisation pick.

name: Hive
desc: Project management and team collaboration in one workspace. Plan projects, assign tasks and centralize communication so work keeps moving.

name: Fastmail
desc: Private, ad-free email hosting with your own domain. Fast, secure email, calendars and contacts from an independent provider that doesn't mine your data. From 1 August 2026 you pick EU (Amsterdam) or US data residency, encrypted at rest on Fastmail's own servers — note that EU data is initially still replicated and backed up to the US while that infrastructure matures.

name: FullEnrich
desc: B2B contact enrichment with waterfall data. Find verified emails and direct phone numbers for prospects by combining 15+ data sources in one lookup.

name: Brevo
desc: Email, SMS and a light CRM, priced by monthly send volume rather than contact count — cheaper for a large list you email selectively. Free forever at 300 emails a day with unlimited contacts; paid from about $9/month. Model your real send volume if you mail frequently.

name: MRPeasy
desc: Cloud manufacturing ERP for small manufacturers. Plan production, track inventory and manage orders and procurement so a growing workshop runs without spreadsheets.

name: Capsule
desc: Deliberately simple CRM for small businesses: contacts, pipeline and tasks. Free for 250 contacts and two users, then about $21/user/month on Starter. The simplicity is the product — advanced automation, deep reporting and integrations thin out, and a scaling sales org can outgrow it.

name: Trainerize
desc: Personal training and fitness-coaching platform. Deliver workout and nutrition plans, message clients and take payments from one branded app, so trainers can coach more clients online.

name: PDWare
desc: Resource and capacity planning for project teams. Plan who works on what, balance workloads and forecast capacity in real time so projects don't stall on people bottlenecks.

name: Nutshell
desc: Sales CRM with built-in email marketing for small teams. Manage your pipeline, automate follow-ups and run campaigns from one place, without enterprise complexity. Full API access is included on every plan.

name: Bookyourdata
desc: B2B email lists and verified contact data on demand. Build targeted prospect lists with verified business emails and pay only for the contacts you need.

name: Sentaro
desc: Email threat detection that flags phishing, risky and malicious messages right in your inbox. Surfaces the dangerous emails that look perfectly normal — before anyone clicks.

name: BuddyPunch
desc: Time clock and employee time tracking for hourly teams. Track hours, breaks, PTO and overtime with GPS and photo punch-in, and export payroll-ready reports.

name: Leadfeeder
desc: Website visitor identification for B2B sales. See which companies visit your site and what they viewed, and turn anonymous traffic into a warm pipeline.

name: lemlist
desc: Cold email outreach and sales engagement. Build personalized multichannel sequences (email, LinkedIn, calls) with built-in deliverability tools, and trigger them off buying-intent signals its agents surface.

name: Atto
desc: Time tracking and timesheets for hourly and mobile teams. Track hours, breaks and locations with GPS and turn timesheets into payroll-ready reports.

name: Breezy HR
desc: Recruiting and applicant tracking made simple. Post jobs to 50+ boards, manage candidates on a visual pipeline, and automate scheduling and screening.

name: Kartra
desc: All-in-one platform for selling online: landing pages, email automation, funnels, memberships and checkout in one tool — no plugins to stitch together.

name: Barcodes Talk
desc: Authentic UPC and EAN barcodes for retail and Amazon listings. Buy GS1-sourced barcodes for your products as a one-time purchase, without an annual GS1 membership.

name: NiceJob
desc: Automates asking customers for reviews and showcases them on your site. Reviews runs about $75/month and Pro around $125, plus a one-off setup fee near $199. Reporting and customisation are fairly basic, and the automation only amplifies the service you already deliver.

name: SMTP2GO
desc: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery. Send via a simple SMTP relay or API with strong deliverability, real-time analytics and global sending infrastructure.

name: Kit
desc: Email marketing built for creators (formerly ConvertKit). Grow your list with landing pages and forms, then automate newsletters and sell digital products from one place; a beta Kit MCP connects AI assistants like Claude directly to your account. Recent additions: a new landing-page editor, Dynamic Content, Newsletter Sponsorships, and App Store integrations on paid plans — SMS via SlickText, Patreon member sync (tier and support data in automations), Luma/Eventbrite event sync, and two-way HubSpot CRM sync on Pro.

name: UniTel Voice
desc: Virtual business phone system for small teams. Get a toll-free or local number with auto-attendant, call routing and a mobile app — no hardware.

name: Passpack
desc: Team password manager for small businesses and MSPs. Store, share and organize credentials with zero-knowledge encryption, role-based access, MFA, device registration, full audit trails and shared team vaults — at a low per-user price.

name: ZoomInfo
desc: Enterprise B2B sales intelligence and contact database. Find verified company and contact data, buying signals and org charts to fuel outbound at scale.

name: Switcher Studio
desc: Multi-camera live production and streaming from iPhones and iPads you already own, with overlays and pay-per-view monetisation. Studio runs around $45/month on annual billing. iOS-only — no Android or desktop app — and wireless multi-cam is only as reliable as the venue's Wi-Fi.

name: Blinq
desc: Digital business cards shared by QR code or link, with contacts syncing into your CRM. A free plan covers two cards; Business is about $4.99/user/month annual with a five-user minimum, and the event lead-capture add-on starts near $199/month.

name: VWO
desc: A/B testing and conversion optimization platform. Run experiments, heatmaps and personalization to lift conversions without developers.

name: Connecteam
desc: All-in-one app for managing deskless teams. Scheduling, time clock, tasks, training and team chat for hourly and frontline workforces.

name: BugHerd
desc: Visual bug tracking and website feedback. Let clients and teams point-and-click to report issues right on the page, turned into trackable tasks.

name: iContact
desc: Straightforward email marketing for growing businesses. Build campaigns and automations with drag-and-drop design and deliverability support.

name: Campaigner
desc: Email and SMS marketing for mid-market senders with larger lists. The useful features start high — automation and API only arrive on Essential at about $179/month, while Starter at $59 is a sending tool rather than an automation platform. Contact-based pricing bills dormant subscribers too.

name: LearnWorlds
desc: Create, sell and scale online courses. Build a branded school with interactive video, assessments, certificates and a built-in checkout.

name: WhatConverts
desc: Lead tracking and marketing attribution. Capture calls, forms and chats and tie every lead back to the campaign that drove it, for clear ROI.

name: Hopp
desc: Digital business cards and lead capture for teams, with contact details shared by link or QR. Several products share the Hopp name and public pricing beyond the free tier is fragmented, so confirm which product you are evaluating and get current rates in writing.

name: Carbon6
desc: SPS Commerce Revenue Recovery — the toolset formerly sold as Carbon6, acquired by SPS Commerce on 7 Feb 2025 and folded into spscommerce.com. Recovers retailer deductions, chargebacks and shortages for 1P suppliers across Amazon, Walmart, Target and Kroger, alongside SoStocked, ScanUnlimited and SPS Ad Performance (formerly PixelMe). Note: the 3P Amazon FBA reimbursement arm was divested on 30 Jun 2026 to an undisclosed buyer.

name: Housecall Pro
desc: Field service management for home-service businesses. Schedule jobs, dispatch techs, send quotes and invoices, and take payments from one app.

name: Spocket
desc: Dropshipping platform with vetted US and EU suppliers. Find fast-shipping products, add them to your store in a click and automate order fulfillment.

name: CallRail
desc: Call tracking and attribution — which campaigns, keywords and ads produce phone calls and form leads. Plans run about $50–195/month, but included minutes, numbers and SMS are modest and overages meter at roughly $0.05 a local minute. It is an attribution layer, not a phone system or CRM.

name: Aspire
desc: All-in-one finance stack for global businesses: multi-currency accounts (30+ currencies), corporate cards with 1.2% cashback, expense management, bill pay, payments and payroll — with AI fraud detection and multi-admin approval workflows.

name: Checkr
desc: AI-powered background check and screening platform for hiring: fast criminal, employment and identity verification with automated adjudication and ATS integrations — speeds up onboarding while staying FCRA-compliant.

name: Freshchat
desc: AI-powered customer messaging from Freshworks: live chat and chatbots across your website, app, WhatsApp and Instagram, with a unified agent inbox and automation that deflects repetitive questions.

name: Birch
desc: Ad automation for performance marketers (formerly Revealbot): rule-based optimization, automated scaling and creative insights across Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat — run and optimize ad campaigns on autopilot.

name: Freshservice
desc: AI-powered IT service management (ITSM) from Freshworks: cloud help desk, ticketing, asset management and workflow automation to run IT support and internal service desks without heavy ITIL overhead.

name: AWeber
desc: Email marketing and automation for small businesses and creators: drag-and-drop newsletters, landing pages, autoresponders and sign-up forms with AI writing help — one of the longest-running email platforms.

name: InboxAlly
desc: Email deliverability tool that trains your sender reputation: engagement-based signals keep your campaigns and cold outreach out of spam and in the primary inbox — works alongside any ESP or email platform.

name: Gelato
desc: Global print-on-demand platform: design, produce and ship custom products (apparel, wall art, mugs, photo books) locally in 30+ countries with no inventory — integrates with Shopify, Etsy and WooCommerce.

name: AfterSell
desc: Post-purchase upsell and cross-sell app for Shopify (by Rokt): one-click upsells, downsells and thank-you-page offers plus checkout customization to lift average order value — no extra ad spend.

name: SMTP.com
desc: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery via SMTP relay and API: high-deliverability sending for app notifications, receipts and campaigns, with real-time analytics and dedicated IPs — built for volume senders.

name: 1Password
desc: Password manager and security platform for teams: store and share passwords, passkeys and secrets with autofill, breach monitoring and developer secrets management — enterprise-grade vaults with simple admin controls.

name: Stamped
desc: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.

name: Streak
desc: CRM built directly inside Gmail: manage pipelines, leads and deals from your inbox with email tracking, mail merge and shared views — ideal for teams that live in Google Workspace.

name: Wati
desc: WhatsApp Business API platform for sales and support: shared team inbox, bulk broadcasts and no-code chatbots — plus Astra, its AI agent builder for agents that actually resolve conversations (orders, refunds, bookings, lead qualification) across WhatsApp, web and voice. Its omnichannel inbox now also carries TikTok DMs natively (all plans, no extra cost) alongside Instagram and RCS — with ad-to-chat context that shows exactly which TikTok ad triggered a conversation. It now ships its own MCP server as well: connect Claude or ChatGPT once and manage contacts, send WhatsApp campaigns, read past chats and build agents in plain language, while sends still run on your own approved templates and the full history stays in the Wati dashboard. Wati's own page puts the cost like this: free for current paid Astra customers with no usage cap during launch, and full MCP access on every Astra plan for new customers (checked 4 Aug 2026).

name: Tapstitch
desc: Fashion-first print-on-demand for brand-builders: premium heavyweight blanks (streetwear tees, oversized hoodies), bigger print areas and made-to-order apparel with no inventory — integrates with Shopify.

name: Getscreen
desc: Browser-based remote desktop and remote-support software: connect to any computer with no client install, share one-click access links, transfer files and record sessions — for IT teams, MSPs and remote support.

name: Instapage
desc: Enterprise landing-page and conversion platform: build, personalize and A/B-test post-click landing pages at scale, with ad-to-page mapping, heatmaps and fast AMP pages — built for paid-ads and demand-gen teams.

name: Feedvisor
desc: AI-driven Amazon and retail-media optimization: dynamic repricing, ad automation and analytics for brands and larger sellers on Amazon and Walmart.

name: TicketTailor
desc: Low-fee event ticketing and box-office software: sell tickets online, manage check-in and keep more of your revenue without per-ticket booking fees.

name: Auware
desc: AI-built, audience-specific Shopify pages: automatically generates a personalized page per buyer persona — not just landing pages but advertorials, listicles, comparison and product (PDP) pages — with targeted headlines, social proof and FAQs, plus per-segment analytics. Built to lift ad conversion for DTC brands. No code.

name: Zeffy
desc: Fundraising, ticketing and donation payments for nonprofits at genuinely $0 — no platform, transaction or card-processing fees. The model is an optional tip prompt shown to your donors at checkout, which they can set to zero. Weigh that against the 2–5% paid platforms take from every donation.

name: SurveyMonkey
desc: Survey and feedback platform: build surveys, collect responses at scale and analyze results for market research, CX and employee feedback. A native Salesforce integration pushes responses straight into Salesforce, triggers workflows off the answers themselves (churn-risk follow-up or an NPS detractor landing on a rep's desk, for instance) and ties feedback back to accounts and pipeline, so sales and CS read it inside the tool they already work in rather than in a separate reporting dashboard.

name: Pipedrive
desc: Sales-first CRM built around a visual pipeline: track deals, automate follow-ups and forecast revenue — designed for small and mid-size sales teams. A native MCP server (launched mid-2026) connects it to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude for natural-language CRM actions.

name: Notify Me
desc: Shopify app to recover lost sales on out-of-stock products: back-in-stock notifications, pre-orders and wishlists that keep customers buying instead of bouncing.

name: HiBob
desc: HRIS with onboarding, time-off and people analytics, built for scaling mid-size companies. Quote-only, per employee per month: third-party estimates cluster in the mid-teens, plus a one-off implementation fee reported at roughly 10–20% of the annual value. Get the number in writing.

name: Kixie
desc: Power dialer with SMS and CRM integration for outbound sales teams, billed quarterly from about $35/user/month. Minutes are not included and the multi-line dialer and AI voice detection are add-ons, so a realistic all-in lands nearer $110–220/user/month.

name: Finale Inventory
desc: Inventory and warehouse management for e-commerce and wholesale: multi-channel stock sync, purchasing and barcode workflows that scale with order volume.

name: Beefree
desc: RGE Studio (formerly Beefree — renamed 14 May 2026): drag-and-drop email and landing-page design. Build responsive, on-brand emails fast and export clean HTML to any major ESP, no coding required. Beefree remains the company name and the name of its separate developer SDK; the builder itself now lives under reallygoodemails.com.

name: Crazy Egg
desc: Website optimization with heatmaps, scroll maps, session recordings and A/B testing — see how visitors behave and lift conversions with data.

name: Wing Assistant
desc: Managed virtual assistants for founders and teams: delegate admin, inbox, scheduling and repetitive tasks to a dedicated, trained assistant.

name: SimpleTexting
desc: SMS marketing and business texting: run mass-text campaigns, two-way conversations and automations with compliance built in.

name: Dext
desc: Receipt and invoice capture that extracts the data and feeds it into Xero, QuickBooks or Sage. It is the capture layer, not accounting software, so you still need one of those. From about £24/month on Starter, and extraction accuracy varies enough to need manual correction.

name: Fireflies.ai
desc: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes your calls across Zoom, Google Meet and Teams — searchable notes, action items and CRM sync, so nobody takes minutes by hand.

name: Pixel Union
desc: Premium Shopify themes bought once rather than by subscription: Pixel Union themes around $300–340 and Out of the Sandbox themes roughly $350–495. A theme is a starting point — the conversion lift comes from how you configure and populate it, not from the purchase.

name: Tenable
desc: Exposure and vulnerability management (makers of Nessus): scan, prioritize and remediate security weaknesses across IT, cloud and OT — for security teams of any size.

name: Riverside
desc: Records podcasts and video locally at each end, so guests on poor connections still come out broadcast-quality. The meter is separate-track recording time: Pro is $29/month for 15 hours, and hitting the cap stops new separate-track downloads until the next cycle rather than billing you more.

name: ZenZap
desc: Secure work-chat for teams — organized channels, built-in tasks and workflows, AI agents and admin controls, as easy to use as texting.

name: Uniqode
desc: Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards with real-time scan analytics — connect offline touchpoints to measurable results and capture leads.

name: Shoeboxed
desc: Turn paper and digital receipts into organized, IRS-ready expense data with OCR plus human verification — syncs with QuickBooks and Xero.

name: Sellfy
desc: No-code store builder for creators to sell digital products, subscriptions and print-on-demand merch — with zero transaction fees and built-in social-media selling.

name: Tellent
desc: Modular people-management platform — applicant tracking (Recruitee), core HR and performance management with AI automation, for hiring and managing teams.

name: VidPal
desc: Autonomous content engine for faceless and topic-based channels: it discovers trending stories in your niche, auto-generates short-form videos and carousels with AI voiceovers, and auto-publishes them across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.

name: LettrLabs
desc: Automated direct-mail marketing: design, personalise and send physical mailers — handwritten letters, postcards — at scale, synced with your digital campaigns and tracked for ROI.

name: ExpertEx
desc: A unified AI studio: chat across multiple models (GPT-4, Gemini), generate images, video and voice, and reuse prompts — multilingual, all in one workspace.

name: Guesty
desc: Property management for short-term and vacation rentals: bookings, guest messaging, channel distribution and pricing in one dashboard. Guesty Lite is roughly $9/month plus about 1% per reservation for one to three listings; Pro and Enterprise are custom-quoted. Heavy for a single listing.

name: Alvys
desc: Cloud-native transportation management system (TMS) unifying trucking carriers and freight brokers in one platform — dispatch, billing, DOT/IFTA compliance, real-time load visibility and native EDI (no third-party middleware), so new shippers connect in hours rather than weeks.

name: Prezi
desc: AI presentation maker for dynamic, non-linear decks that stand out from standard slides — turn ideas into polished, interactive presentations fast.

name: QuickSigner
desc: Legally-binding e-signatures with unlimited documents and no per-envelope caps: send a secure link and recipients sign from any device without creating an account. ISO/IEC 27001-certified, AATL signatures, valid across the US, UK and EU — a fair-priced DocuSign alternative.

name: Plansom
desc: AI-assisted planning for tasks, goals and team collaboration, with a free Starter tier that keeps tasks unlimited. Pro is about $14.99/month or $149.99 a year. A smaller player next to Asana and ClickUp, with fewer integrations and a smaller ecosystem around it.

name: Superfiliate
desc: Creator-led growth for D2C brands: run influencer, affiliate and referral programs in one platform across Shopify, Meta and TikTok Shop — discovery, automation, gifting and revenue tracking.

name: Dryground AI
desc: Full-stack AI implementation services: helps businesses design and integrate AI across their tech stack — for teams that want AI built and shipped, not just advised.

name: Sendcloud
desc: European e-commerce shipping platform: connect 160+ carriers, print labels in batches, show delivery options at checkout, send branded tracking (email, WhatsApp, SMS) and run a self-service returns portal — with rules-based shipping automation. Available to online retailers in 8 countries (Netherlands, Belgium, UK, France, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain). Free plan available.

name: AgencyAnalytics
desc: Client reporting and dashboards built for marketing agencies: aggregate 80+ marketing platforms into white-label dashboards and automated reports, with per-client KPI goals. White-labeling on every plan.

name: Healthie
desc: All-in-one practice management and EHR for health, wellness and nutrition providers: scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, billing and a branded client portal — plus a full API (GraphQL + webhooks) for automation. Built to scale with group practices.

name: Arbor
desc: Free US service that automatically finds and switches you to a cheaper electricity supply rate in the 13 deregulated states (Northeast, Midwest, Texas). Your utility and wiring stay the same, no service interruption, cancel anytime — Arbor is paid a referral fee by the supplier, so households pay nothing.

name: Shore
desc: Booking and business software for local service businesses (salons, barbers, wellness, coaches): 24/7 online appointments via your website, Google and Instagram, calendar and staff scheduling, client profiles, automated reminders that cut no-shows, plus email marketing and POS. Fixed monthly price with unlimited bookings — no per-booking commission.

name: Velora
desc: Unified operations platform for nonprofits: Keela (donor CRM), Aplos (fund accounting) and Raisely (online fundraising) as one connected suite — donor management, campaigns and finances built for charities instead of adapted from business software.

name: Hello Bar
desc: Sticky bars, popups, slide-ins and full-screen takeovers for lead capture, with A/B testing and targeting rules. The meter is popup views rather than signups, so a traffic spike raises the bill however few emails you captured. Reported tiers start near $29–39/month for roughly 50k views.

name: PushOwl
desc: Shopify web-push and omnichannel marketing, now part of Brevo. One-click push lets stores re-engage shoppers who never leave an email — recovering abandoned carts and browsing sessions — then layer in email, SMS and WhatsApp on Brevo's deliverability stack. Usage-based pricing: you pay for what you send, not list size.

name: Claude
desc: Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, coding, analysis and long-document work — strong reasoning and a careful, direct tone rather than an eager-to-please one. Free tier plus Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, and a per-token API (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) for builders.

name: UltaHost
desc: Budget-friendly web hosting across shared, VPS, WordPress and dedicated plans — NVMe SSD storage, free SSL and migration, DDoS protection and 24/7 multilingual support, from 30+ global data centers.

name: Descript
desc: AI-powered video and podcast editor: edit media by editing the text transcript — cut, overdub and remove filler words like editing a doc — with screen recording, AI voice cloning and an AI assistant (Underlord) built in.

name: Miro
desc: Visual collaboration platform: an infinite online whiteboard for brainstorms, diagrams, workshops and planning — with templates, voting and AI that generates diagrams and summaries, built for real-time and async teamwork.

name: Circle
desc: Community platform for creator businesses: discussions, courses, events, memberships and messaging in one branded home — plus a no-code website builder, branded iOS/Android apps, email marketing, a member CRM, built-in payments and AI agents that answer member questions.

name: Survicate
desc: Customer feedback platform for continuous surveys: NPS, CSAT and in-product micro-surveys across web, in-app, email and link — with templates, audience targeting and native integrations (Segment and RudderStack among them) that pipe feedback straight into your CRM and analytics.

name: Restream
desc: Multistreaming studio: broadcast one show to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitch at once from the browser, with guests and local recordings. The channel caps are the business model — 3 on Standard at about $16/month annual, 5 on Professional — and each extra teammate is a $25/month seat.

name: Momence
desc: Booking and business management for class-based businesses — yoga and fitness studios, gyms, salons and schools: scheduling, memberships, payments, marketing automations and a member app in one place.

name: Heard
desc: Done-for-you bookkeeping and taxes built for therapists and a growing range of health-and-wellness practices — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists: monthly books, quarterly tax estimates, annual filing and S-corp support by specialists who know the niche.

name: Evolve
desc: AI-native training and enablement platform for enterprises: an LMS with branded academies, an AI course generator, job-skill simulations with AI counterparts, an assessment center and performance analytics — used by 100+ deployed enterprises.

name: ExpertSender
desc: E-commerce marketing automation with a built-in customer data platform: email, SMS, web and mobile push plus on-site messages, behavior-triggered workflows, product recommendations and segmentation on unified store data.

name: FlexiQuiz
desc: Online quiz and test maker for educators, trainers and businesses: build graded exams, assessments and simple courses with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — from a genuinely free tier.

name: ElevenLabs
desc: Market-leading AI voice platform: hyper-realistic text-to-speech, voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects and conversational agents — with a developer API and a free tier to test voices before you pay.

name: Buzz.ai
desc: AI-powered outbound platform: prompt it and it finds intent-ready buyers, writes multichannel sequences and books the meetings — per-seat plans with monthly credit allowances and a free start.

name: involve.me
desc: Interactive funnel builder: quizzes, calculators, assessments and payment pages with built-in email sequences — free tier to start, paid tiers priced by live-funnel count from $19/mo annual.

name: Mktg.ai
desc: Always-on AI marketing analyst: unified creative visibility, live performance signals and plain-language questions over your own spend data — no public pricing, demo-first.

name: eDesk
desc: E-commerce helpdesk: one unified inbox for Amazon, eBay, Shopify and email, with order data and an AI Agent that bills per resolved outcome. Free plan; paid from $39/agent/mo (annual).

name: Papaya Global
desc: Enterprise workforce-payments platform unifying global payroll, EOR hiring, contractor management and cross-border payments in one system — finance-first, with same-day local payouts on owned payment rails and deep ERP/HRIS integration. Premium, quote-only pricing.

name: AltText.ai
desc: Bulk AI alt-text generation for image-heavy sites: crawls your pages or plugs into your CMS (WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Contentful, DatoCMS) and writes the alt attributes back automatically, in 130+ languages. Credit-metered — 25 free credits to try, then from $5/mo for 100 images.

name: Cloudways
desc: Managed-hosting layer that rents you servers on DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, AWS or Google Cloud through one dashboard, with the stack, caching, staging, cloning, backups and 24/7 platform support pre-built on top. You buy a server and put as many sites on it as it holds — no per-site plans and no visit metering — billed hourly and invoiced monthly in arrears with no contract. The trade is control: Cloudways' own documentation states there is no root access and no bring-your-own cloud account, so the server lives in Cloudways' name. Owned by DigitalOcean since September 2022.

name: TextExpander
desc: Text-expansion tool: you type a short abbreviation and it expands into a stored snippet system-wide on macOS and Windows and in Chrome, with fill-in fields, nested snippets, date maths and scripting. The real product is the team layer — a shared snippet library with permissions, sign-up by email domain, auto-subscribe for new hires, usage statistics and SSO — aimed at support, clinical-admin, recruiting and sales teams that need everyone sending the same approved wording. The vendor self-attests SOC 2/SOC 3 and HIPAA compliance with a BAA available, which is the clearest argument for paying rather than using a free expander. From $3.33 per user/month billed annually; no free plan, 30-day trial without a credit card.

name: SEO Space
desc: SEO tool built exclusively for Squarespace, delivered as a Chrome extension paired with a web dashboard. The extension runs inside the Squarespace editor and on live pages, scoring each page and saying in plain language what to change and where the setting lives; the dashboard adds site-wide audits, keyword rank tracking, backlink and competitor data, local SEO tools and scheduled white-label PDF client reports. Pricing is keyed to the number of websites rather than seats, which is why it suits freelancers and studios managing client sites. There is a genuinely usable free plan; paid starts at $18.99/month for one site.

name: Zedonk
desc: Fashion-industry ERP for small and mid-size brands — modular sales, production, inventory and wholesale management with a B2B digital showroom, priced per module from £166/mo billed annually.

name: Seller Snap
desc: AI repricer and seller-analytics platform for Amazon and Walmart — what the vendor calls game-theory repricing, aimed at Buy Box share rather than racing to the bottom, plus min/max profit calculation, 80+ analytics data points and imports from tools like InventoryLab and SkuVault. Starter is $100/month billed annually (annual only); month-to-month starts at $250. 15-day free trial, no credit card. A July 2026 interface release adds live Buy Box insight with SKU-level filters, multi-store management from one screen including bulk cost updates, repricing from mobile, historical inventory-value tracking, saved views, customizable columns and a dark mode.

name: ZenBusiness
desc: US business-formation service — LLC, S corp and C corp filings at $0 plus the state's own fee, with the money in the recurring stack around it: registered agent $199/year, Worry-Free Compliance $199/year (Advanced $299/year), operating agreement $99, EIN $99. Add-ons are priced individually rather than bundled into tiers (site, verified 25 Jul 2026).

name: Pingtree
desc: AI-assisted funnel builder and lead-distribution platform — build funnels and forms by prompt, then route, track and monetise the leads across lead-gen, affiliate and media-buying campaigns.

name: Top Echelon
