desc: Recruiting software for agencies and staffing firms: TE Recruit is an ATS and CRM with resume parsing, pipeline management, hotlists and job-board integrations, while TE Network is a split-placement network for sharing roles and candidates with other recruiting firms.

name: Compliancely
desc: Compliance and verification API for US businesses and individuals: real-time and bulk IRS TIN matching, KYB business verification, USPS address and Secretary of State lookups, Form I-9 and E-Verify, consent-based IRS tax transcript retrieval, and ongoing OFAC, watchlist and FATCA monitoring. Built by Zenwork, the company behind Tax1099.

name: Deputy
desc: Workforce management for hourly and shift-based teams: rota building, time clocking, timesheet approval and labour-law compliance, with payroll and HR integrations.

name: Glide
desc: No-code app builder that turns spreadsheets and databases into working business apps — internal tools, client portals and field apps, with workflows and an API.

name: Spiky.ai
desc: AI meeting intelligence for revenue teams — records and analyses sales calls, tracks keywords and talk patterns, and coaches reps. Free tier at 3 meetings per user, then $15 to $40 per user per month on annual billing.

name: Proton
desc: Privacy-first suite from the makers of ProtonMail — encrypted mail, calendar, drive, VPN and password manager under one account, with a free tier and paid bundles.

name: QuickBooks UK
desc: Intuit's accounting platform for the UK market — bookkeeping, VAT and Making Tax Digital submissions, invoicing and payroll as a paid add-on. Annual plans run from £108 for sole traders to £604.80 for the five-user tier, excluding VAT, with a 30-day trial.
Work management platform with boards, automations and views — plus separately-priced CRM, Dev and Service products.
name: monday.com

desc: Customer service suite: ticketing, messaging, voice, help centre and AI agents.
name: Zendesk

desc: Interactive product demos you can embed, with analytics on who watched what.
name: Storylane

desc: Employer of record and global contractor management for hiring where you have no legal entity. EOR is $699 per employee a month, contractors $29. Two costs sit in the FAQ rather than on the price card: a refundable deposit per EOR employee, and an FX fee when payment and contract currency differ.
name: Oyster

desc: DMARC, SPF and DKIM monitoring — stop others sending email as your domain.
name: EasyDMARC

desc: Video hosting built for marketing — player customisation, viewer analytics and lead capture.
name: Wistia

desc: Booking, point of sale and client management for salons, spas and self-care businesses.
name: Boulevard

desc: Multi-currency business accounts, corporate cards, international transfers and payment acceptance.
name: Airwallex

desc: Product analytics: funnels, retention and behavioural cohorts, plus session replay and experimentation.
name: Amplitude

desc: Competitive intelligence on web traffic, search and ads — what your competitors' visitors do.
name: Similarweb

desc: B2B contact data with a GDPR focus — phone-verified mobile numbers and intent signals.
name: Cognism

desc: Password manager and privileged access management for teams, with a zero-knowledge architecture.
name: Keeper Security

desc: Visual website builder that writes production code — design, CMS, hosting and ecommerce in one place.
name: Webflow

desc: Workplace platform for visitor sign-in, desk and room booking, deliveries and emergency notifications.
name: Envoy

desc: Suite of separately-sold products: Freshdesk support, Freshservice IT, Freshsales CRM, Freshchat and Freshcaller.
name: Freshworks

desc: Dynamic repricing for Amazon and Walmart sellers — automated price strategy across marketplaces.
name: Aura

desc: Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat.
name: Gorgias

desc: Pre-employment skills testing: assessment library, custom questions and candidate scoring.
name: TestGorilla

desc: Modular HR, payroll and recruitment platform for small and mid-size employers.
name: Employment Hero

desc: Fleet management: ELD compliance, AI dash cams, vehicle tracking and driver safety scoring.
name: Motive

desc: Case management for law firms: matters, intake, depositions, e-signature and AI document work.
name: Filevine

desc: Cloud accounting for small business: bank reconciliation, invoicing, bills and reporting.
name: Xero

desc: Invoicing and accounting aimed at freelancers and service businesses, priced by billable clients.
name: FreshBooks

desc: Time tracking with screenshots, activity levels, GPS and payroll integration for distributed teams.
name: Hubstaff

desc: Job management for trades and service contractors: scheduling, quotes, job cards and invoicing.
name: ServiceM8

desc: Daily planning that pulls tasks from your other tools into one deliberate schedule.
name: Sunsama

desc: Behavioural messaging: email, push and in-app campaigns driven by product events rather than lists.
name: Customer.io

desc: SMS marketing for Shopify stores: campaigns, automations and opt-in tools.
name: Postscript

desc: Business SMS for support and sales teams: shared inboxes, automations and compliance tooling.
name: Textline

desc: Endpoint protection built around a cloud-delivered agent: antivirus, EDR and threat hunting.
name: CrowdStrike

desc: All-in-one platform for small service businesses: CRM, scheduling, invoicing, reviews and marketing.
name: Thryv

desc: Meeting recorder and note-taker: transcription, summaries and searchable meeting history.
name: MeetGeek

desc: Advertising optimisation for Amazon and Walmart sellers, with inventory and catalogue signals.
name: Teikametrics

desc: Time and attendance tracking with facial recognition, GPS and payroll-ready timesheets.
name: Jibble
Seel
desc: Shopper-paid returns and shipping protection for Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce. Customers add Worry-Free Purchase at checkout and Seel pays the refund instead of you — free for the merchant.

name: SimplyBook.me
desc: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses — booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments. Free plan for 50 bookings a month with one provider; paid plans from EUR 11.90 a month billed annually.

name: Salesflow
desc: LinkedIn outreach automation for outbound sales teams — connection requests, follow-up sequences and Open InMails, with email steps for multichannel campaigns, plus admin panel, seat management and shared templates for agencies. Priced per seat, from about $79 per user per month billed annually.

name: Pippit
desc: AI marketing-content maker by CapCut — turns a product link into marketing videos, avatar presenters, talking photos and sales posters, with scheduling and multi-platform publishing. Credit-based, with a free tier that needs no card. Seedance 2.5 is now listed among its video models: clips up to 30 seconds, text timestamps to pin key moments, footage extension for longer scenes and reference inputs to steer the direction — although their own model page still describes it with "upcoming" wording (checked 4 Aug 2026).

name: BidX
desc: Amazon-advertising automation from German vendor BidX GmbH: bid and budget automation, campaign creation, dayparting and target-ACOS rules for Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, with Amazon DSP and Marketing Cloud reporting and organic-plus-paid share-of-voice tracking in the same dashboard.

name: Piktochart
desc: Infographic, report and poster maker with template libraries and AI credits — the free plan allows 2 downloads, Pro is $10 per member/month billed annually, and PDF/PowerPoint export starts at Business ($17).

name: accessiBe
desc: Web-accessibility widget (accessWidget) that scans a site every 24 hours and adjusts it in the browser — contrast, text sizing, keyboard hints — plus an accessibility statement. Priced by monthly visits: $490/year up to 5,000, $1,490 up to 30,000, $3,990 up to 100,000. An aid, not WCAG conformance.

name: Signal House
desc: SMS and Voice API positioned as a Twilio alternative. Usage-based with no platform fee: $0.0065 per SMS segment with no minimum, down to $0.0030 above 10m, and $1.00 a month per local number. A2P 10DLC fees are published; voice rates are not.

name: Remote People
desc: Employer of Record and global hiring in 150+ countries. EOR from $199 per employee a month with no setup fee, no deposit and no minimum headcount; contractor management from $29, US PEO from $99. Recruitment is charged separately at 20-25% of annual salary.

name: Quartile
desc: Retail media optimisation across Amazon Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP, Walmart, Instacart, Criteo, Google, Meta and Microsoft, sold as a platform plus a dedicated account team rather than a self-serve tool. Demo-led with no public pricing of any kind: no tiers, no entry rate, nothing on the pricing page (read 7 Aug 2026). The 41% average ROAS uplift on their homepage is the vendor's own claim.

name: Nouswise
desc: AI research agent that answers only from a library you curate — your documents plus vetted sources — with reports, flashcards and audio recaps on every tier, and MCP tools, web search and a shared workspace only from Pro up. Built for knowledge-intensive and regulated organisations: SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type I/II, data in Europe or the US, and an on-premises install for confidential material. Published pricing is 0$ Starter, 19.99$/month Essential and 49.99$/month Pro with Enterprise on quote (read 12 Aug 2026), but their own homepage shows $10 and $40 for the same tiers, so get the figure confirmed before you subscribe. The “100% verifiable, zero fabrication” claim is the vendor's own.
